messages:
Elena (People Ops): Heads-up: coordinating benefits Q&A + mini recognition pop-up at the London office on 6/3. combo event: 20-min benefits walk-through + 15-min 'thank-a-peer' station with instant e-cards. Need a lead for benefits and someone to run e-cards.
Samir (Benefits): I can do the benefits slot. Will prepare slides on open enrollment changes and commuter benefits. Need projector <> adapter listed in AV form.
Jules (People Ops): I'll run the e-card station and set up a tablet with templates. We should also offer print-out thank-you notes for people who prefer paper.
Hao (Global Ops): note re: legal: check local tax implications for gift cards in UK. If we do instant small-value gift cards, confirm grossing requirement.
Elena (People Ops): good catch. @Hao can you check with legal by 1805551300?
Hao (Global Ops): yes will check and post result.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: AV form needed by 1805551350 for adapter procurement.
Samir (Benefits): sample agenda:
1) intro 5m
2) 10m walk-through of changes + FAQs
3) 5m enrollment next steps + office hours signup
4) 15m thank-a-peer activity

Elena (People Ops): We should keep the benefits content high-level; deep dives in follow-up office hours. Also include a 1-slide 'how to update beneficiaries' (it's a common ask).
Jules (People Ops): tablet setup requires wifi guest creds — facilities can we confirm network access?
people-ops-bot: Facilities request ticket #FAC-180555 created.
Hao (Global Ops): Legal: for <20 GBP e-cards, UK doesn't require grossing but we need to keep a record. No policy block.
Elena (People Ops): Great. Let's finalize sign-up link and RSVP cap at 40. I'll post the invite and ask for volunteers to staff the e-card table.
Samir (Benefits): Will add a short FAQ doc to the invite.
Jules (People Ops): I'll bring stickers and a stamp for hand-written notes. Volunteers: please DM me.
Elena (People Ops): thanks team. Follow-ups: Samir upload slides; Jules confirm tablet; Hao post legal note; people-ops-bot: remind volunteers 1805551450.
